roadmap.title: Normal story and shooting-gallery cleanup
roadmap.description: Complete the main story on Normal, trigger both optional chapter achievements before passing their locations, and collect all 24 bottle caps once game type D becomes available in Chapter 5-1.

roadmap.title: Separate Ways and costume completion
roadmap.description: Open Extras after the Normal clear and complete Separate Ways to unlock Special Costume 2 alongside the Special Costume 1 set earned from the main story.

roadmap.title: Fresh Professional playthrough
roadmap.description: Choose New Game and Professional from the title menu, equip Special Costume 2 if desired, and finish the entire main story on the highest difficulty.

achievements.description: Ring the mysterious bell. What happens after that, is up to you.
achievements.summary: Survive the @loc{Chapter 1-1 village battle} until the church bell rings and the villagers withdraw.

guide.context: The bell sequence is mandatory story progress, so this first campaign achievement cannot be missed.

steps.text: Enter the central village in @loc{Chapter 1-1} and trigger the Ganado attack.
Fight or evade the villagers until the church bell cutscene ends the encounter and unlocks the achievement.

achievements.description: Summon the master of the lake. Don't rock the boat.
achievements.summary: Before boarding the @loc{Chapter 1-3 lake boat}, shoot the water from the dock until Del Lago kills Leon and unlocks the achievement.

guide.context: Del Lago's attack kills Leon, so use the nearby typewriter first and reload that save after the achievement appears.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 1-3}, save at the typewriter before stepping onto the motorboat at the lake.
Stand at the end of the dock and fire repeatedly into the open water until @enemy{Del Lago} leaps out and kills Leon.
Wait for the achievement to unlock, then reload the typewriter save to continue toward the lake battle.

achievements.displayName: A Rock and a Hard Place
achievements.description: Outmaneuver the rampaging beast, El Gigante.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{El Gigante} during the mandatory quarry battle in Chapter 2-1.

guide.context: Freeing the trapped dog near the beginning of Chapter 1-1 causes it to distract El Gigante, but the rescue is optional for the achievement.

steps.text: Progress through @loc{Chapter 2-1} until the gate closes behind Leon in the quarry.
Damage El Gigante until the Plaga emerges from its back, climb onto the boss, and cut the parasite; keep damaging El Gigante, climbing on when the Plaga reappears, and cutting it until the boss dies.

achievements.description: Rescue the president's daughter, Ashley. Afterwards, the real fun begins.
achievements.summary: Use the @item{Round Insignia} and solve the church light puzzle in Chapter 2-1 to rescue Ashley.

guide.context: The church rescue follows the El Gigante battle and is mandatory story progress.

steps.text: Return to the @loc{Chapter 2-1 church} and use the Round Insignia on the locked entrance.
Climb to the upper floor, cross the chandelier, and operate the colored-light dial puzzle.
Align the colored lights to reproduce the center emblem, confirm the solution, and enter the opened room to rescue @npc{Ashley}.

achievements.description: Defeat the village chief in battle.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Bitores Mendez} in the Chapter 2-3 barn battle.

guide.context: The village chief is a mandatory boss, so completing both phases of the barn fight guarantees the achievement.

steps.text: Progress through @loc{Chapter 2-3} until Leon is trapped with Bitores Mendez inside the burning barn.
Damage Mendez's torso through the first phase, then destroy the upper body during the second phase to finish the fight.

achievements.description: Turn the tables on Verdugo, the right hand of Salazar.
achievements.summary: Freeze and kill @enemy{Verdugo} before taking the Chapter 4-1 underground elevator.

guide.context: The elevator eventually arrives even if Verdugo survives, but leaving on it forfeits the achievement for that playthrough.

steps.text: After Salazar's trap in @loc{Chapter 4-1}, follow the underground tunnels to the power room and activate the elevator power.
When Verdugo approaches a liquid-nitrogen cylinder, knock the cylinder over to freeze the boss.
Attack Verdugo while frozen; a @item{Rocket Launcher} shot during this state is the simplest way to kill the boss before boarding the elevator.

achievements.description: Defeat Salazar, and make your escape from the castle.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Ramon Salazar} during the mandatory Chapter 4-4 castle battle.

guide.context: Salazar's body is protected until damage to the central eye opens the shell, creating the short window for direct attacks.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 4-4}, shoot the exposed central eye until the shell opens and reveals Ramon Salazar.
Attack Salazar's exposed body, then damage the central eye again whenever the shell closes; continue reopening the shell and attacking Salazar until he dies.

achievements.description: Defeat Krauser, your former partner, in battle.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Jack Krauser} and take the third insignia piece in Chapter 5-3.

guide.context: Krauser is unusually vulnerable to close-range Knife attacks, which conserve ammunition and can end the final duel quickly.

steps.text: During @loc{Chapter 5-3}, collect the first two insignia pieces and climb the stairs into Krauser's final arena.
Evade Krauser's arm attacks, strike him with the Knife when he closes in, and continue until he dies.
Collect the third insignia piece left after the battle to complete the encounter.

achievements.description: Defeat Saddler in battle, and escape from the nightmare.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Osmund Saddler} in the Final Chapter and escape the island by jet ski.

guide.context: Defeating Saddler starts a timed escape sequence, so the campaign is not complete until Leon and Ashley reach the island exit.

steps.text: Shoot the eyes on Saddler's legs to stagger him, then damage the large eye exposed on his body.
Catch the @item{Special Rocket Launcher} thrown by Ada and fire it into Saddler to end the boss fight.
Reach Ashley, board the jet ski, and drive through the escape tunnel before the countdown expires.

achievements.description: Clear the game on the highest difficulty.
achievements.summary: Clear the main story on Normal to unlock Professional, then finish a fresh @mechanic{Professional New Game}.

guide.context: Loading a completed Normal save starts New Game Plus on Normal and cannot change the difficulty. Special Costume 2 gives Ashley invulnerable knight armor, but completed-save bonus weapons are unavailable on the fresh Professional file.

steps.text: Complete the main story on @mechanic{Normal} difficulty to add Professional to the New Game difficulty list.
Return to the title menu, choose @mechanic{New Game}, and select Professional instead of loading the completed Normal save.
Complete every chapter and the Final Chapter on the Professional file to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Acquire all of the bottle caps in the game.
achievements.summary: Earn all @item{24 bottle caps} from shooting-gallery games A–D, then leave the gallery and return the loaned weapons to the Merchant to unlock the achievement.

guide.context: The four game types unlock in Chapters 3-1, 4-1, 4-2, and 5-1. From Chapter 5-1 onward, later galleries allow every earlier type to be selected for cleanup.

collectibles.name: Game A — 6 bottle caps
collectibles.method: Earn Leon with Rocket Launcher, Leon with Shotgun, Leon with Handgun, Ashley, Luis, and Ada. Repeat 3,000-point runs for the five standard caps, then hit every enemy target without shooting Ashley or score 4,000 points for the sixth cap.

collectibles.name: Game B — 6 bottle caps
collectibles.method: Earn Villager with Axe, Villager with Sickle, Villager, Villager with Pitchfork, Chainsaw Man, and Chainsaw Sisters. Repeat 3,000-point runs for the five standard caps, then hit every enemy target without shooting Ashley or score 4,000 points for the sixth cap.

collectibles.name: Game C — 6 bottle caps
collectibles.method: Earn Merchant, Cultist with Scythe, Cultist with Shield, Cultist with Bowgun, Cultist Leader, and Villager Parasite. Repeat 3,000-point runs for the five standard caps, then hit every enemy target without shooting Ashley or score 4,000 points for the sixth cap.

collectibles.name: Game D — 6 bottle caps
collectibles.method: Earn Soldier with Dynamite, Soldier with Stun Rod, Soldier with Hammer, Female Villager, Female Villager with Knife, and J.J. Repeat 3,000-point runs for the five standard caps, then hit every enemy target without shooting Ashley or score 4,000 points for the sixth cap; return the loaned weapons to finalize the complete collection.

achievements.description: Acquire all of the costumes in the game.
achievements.summary: Clear the main story to unlock @item{Special Costume 1}, then complete Separate Ways to unlock Special Costume 2.

guide.context: Assignment Ada and The Mercenaries do not unlock either required costume set; only the main-story clear and Separate Ways completion matter.

steps.text: Complete the main story on any difficulty to unlock @item{Special Costume 1} and add Extras to the title menu.
From the title menu, open @mechanic{Extras} and select Separate Ways.
Complete all of Separate Ways on its fixed difficulty to unlock @item{Special Costume 2} and the achievement.
